map.由沉积能量与质量求吸收剂量: Find the absorbed dose from deposited energy and mass
map.输入沉积能量 E 与质量 m，求吸收剂量。: Enter the deposited energy E and the mass m to get the absorbed dose.
map.📖 查看「由沉积能量与质量求吸收剂量 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the absorbed dose from deposited energy and mass"
map.辐射沉积能量 E 除以物质质量 m 得吸收剂量。: Divide the deposited radiation energy E by the mass m of the material to get the absorbed dose.
map.对比不同质量下的剂量强度。: Compare dose intensity across different masses.
map.吸收剂量 D = 0.05 / 1 = 0.05 Gy；若质量减到 0.5kg: Absorbed dose D = 0.05 / 1 = 0.05 Gy; if the mass drops to 0.5 kg then D = 0.1 Gy, since the same energy is more concentrated.
map.吸收剂量是能量/质量（Gy）；当量剂量再乘辐射权重因子 Q（Sv），见 dose: Absorbed dose is energy per mass (Gy); the equivalent dose further multiplies by the radiation weighting factor Q (Sv), see dose-equivalent.
map.Gy 与 Sv 能混用吗？: Can Gy and Sv be used interchangeably?
map.不能，Gy 描述沉积能量，Sv 描述生物危害当量，仅 γ/β（Q=1）时数值相等: No. Gy describes deposited energy and Sv the biological harm equivalent; the values coincide only for γ/β (Q=1).
